regeneration.summary: Active hero is a v2 regeneration. The v1 hero (rejected/img_v1-selfreview-rejected.jpg) was rejected in Cora's self-review: v1 showed frenched/rib-style chops; the plating brief excludes a frenched rack.
regeneration.prompt_change: v2 prompt = v1 prompt verbatim plus one 'Regeneration clarifier:' sentence inserted before the quality-reference sentence. See the 'Regeneration v2 prompt addition' section of image-prompt.md.
regeneration.clarifier_sentence: Regeneration clarifier: the chops are compact, thick, squarish loin chops like miniature T-bone steaks, with a small T-shaped bone in the middle and a fat cap on one side; there are NO long thin protruding rib bones and no frenched bones anywhere.
